entries.heading: Verse 1
entries.text: Ps 117:1, 2 . This may be regarded as a doxology, suitable to be appended to any Psalm of similar character, and prophetical of the prevalence of God's grace in the world, in which aspect Paul quotes it ( Ro 15:11 ; compare Ps 47:2; 66:8 ).

entries.heading: 2. is great toward us
entries.text: 2. is great toward us --literally, "prevailed over" or "protected us."
